title: Pasta with Roasted Butternut Squash and Shallots
ingredients: 8   shallots, peeled and halved lengthwise (about 1/2 pound)
4   ounces uncooked pappardelle (wide ribbon pasta) or fettuccine
1/2   cup (2 ounces) grated fresh Parmesan cheese
method: Combine squash, sugar, 1 tablespoon oil, salt, pepper, and shallots in a jelly roll pan; toss well. Bake at Gas Mark 8 for 20 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally. Stir in sage.
Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. Drain.
Place cooked pasta in a bowl. Add remaining 1 tablespoon oil; toss well.
Serve squash mixture over pasta. Sprinkle with cheese.
Serve with crusty bread and green beans.
